quests.instruction: Which door on a bus or train opens and closes by itself, without anyone pushing it?
quests.hint: Think about the door on a bus that slides open by itself the moment the bus comes to a stop.
quests.explanation: An automatic door opens and closes by itself. Buses and trains use an automatic door at every stop!
quests.funFact: An automatic door uses sensors to know exactly when it is safe to open or close!

quests.instruction: Which special door helps passengers leave a vehicle quickly if there is ever a problem?
quests.hint: Think about the special marked door on a plane or bus, used only if there is ever an emergency.
quests.explanation: An emergency exit is a special door for quick escapes. Emergency exits help passengers leave safely if needed!
quests.funFact: Flight attendants always point out the nearest emergency exit before every single flight takes off!

quests.instruction: Which safety canister sprays foam or powder to help put out a small fire?
quests.hint: Think about the small red canister found on a bus or boat, ready to spray out foam if a small fire starts.
quests.explanation: A fire extinguisher sprays foam to put out fires. Vehicles carry a fire extinguisher for safety!
quests.funFact: Knowing exactly where a fire extinguisher is kept can help everyone feel more prepared and safe!

quests.instruction: Which small box of bandages and supplies helps treat a minor injury during a trip?
quests.hint: Think about the small box packed with bandages, kept in a car or boat in case someone gets a small scrape.
quests.explanation: A first aid kit has bandages for minor injuries. Vehicles carry a first aid kit in case of a small accident!
quests.funFact: A well-stocked first aid kit can help treat small cuts and scrapes right away during a trip!

quests.instruction: Which small tool makes a loud sound to help someone be found if they need help?
quests.hint: Think about the small whistle attached to a life jacket, blown loudly to help rescuers find someone quickly.
quests.explanation: An emergency whistle makes a loud sound to attract help. Life jackets often have an emergency whistle attached!
quests.funFact: A loud whistle can travel much farther than a shouting voice, helping rescuers find someone faster!

quests.instruction: Which small shiny disc on a bicycle bounces back a car's headlights at night?
quests.hint: Think about the small, shiny red disc on the back of a bicycle that glows brightly in a car's headlights.
quests.explanation: A reflector is a shiny disc that bounces back light. Reflectors help a bicycle be seen clearly at night!
quests.funFact: A reflector needs no batteries at all, since it simply bounces back light shining onto it!

quests.instruction: Which blinking lights on all four corners of a car warn others that it has stopped or slowed?
quests.hint: Think about all four blinking lights on a car flashing together to warn others that something is wrong.
quests.explanation: Hazard lights are blinking lights warning of a problem. Drivers switch on hazard lights if their car stops suddenly!
quests.funFact: Switching on hazard lights helps warn drivers behind you to slow down and be extra careful!

quests.instruction: Which small sensor detects rain and automatically switches on a car's windshield wipers?
quests.hint: Think about the small sensor on a windshield that feels the first raindrops and turns the wipers on by itself.
quests.explanation: A rain sensor detects rain and starts the wipers automatically. Rain sensors help drivers keep their eyes on the road!
quests.funFact: A rain sensor can even adjust how fast the wipers move, depending on how hard it is raining!

quests.instruction: Which small sensor beeps faster as a car gets closer to an object while parking?
quests.hint: Think about the small sensors on a car's bumper that beep faster and faster as you back close to a wall.
quests.explanation: A parking sensor beeps to warn of nearby objects. Parking sensors help drivers park safely without bumping anything!
quests.funFact: A parking sensor's beeping gets faster the closer a car gets to something behind it!

quests.instruction: Which open area on a ship or tower lets visitors enjoy a wide view all around?
quests.hint: Think about the open area high on a ship or tower where visitors stand to enjoy an amazing view.
quests.explanation: An observation deck is an area for enjoying a wide view. Visitors gather on an observation deck to take in the scenery!
quests.funFact: An observation deck often sits at the very highest point of a ship or tower for the best view!

quests.instruction: Which ring-shaped float is thrown to someone struggling in the water?
quests.hint: Think about the round, ring-shaped float kept on a boat's deck, ready to be thrown to someone in trouble.
quests.explanation: A life buoy is a ring-shaped float thrown for rescue. Life buoys help keep someone afloat until help arrives!
quests.funFact: A life buoy's bright color helps rescuers spot it quickly, even from far away!

quests.instruction: Which heavy, strong chain connects a ship's anchor to the deck above?
quests.hint: Think about the thick, heavy chain linking a ship's anchor all the way up to the deck above.
quests.explanation: An anchor chain connects an anchor to a ship's deck. Anchor chains must be extremely strong and heavy!
quests.funFact: An anchor chain can be so heavy that a special machine is needed just to pull it back up!

quests.instruction: Which bell on a ship's deck is rung to mark the time or warn other ships nearby?
quests.hint: Think about the bright, polished bell on a ship's deck, rung by a sailor to mark the passing hours.
quests.explanation: A ship's bell marks time or warns other ships. Sailors ring the ship's bell during foggy weather at sea!
quests.funFact: Sailors once used a ship's bell to mark every half hour throughout their long watch at sea!

quests.instruction: Which floating marker bobs in the water to guide ships safely around danger?
quests.hint: Think about the brightly colored floating marker bobbing in the water, warning ships of rocks or shallow water nearby.
quests.explanation: A buoy is a floating marker that guides ships. Buoys warn ships to steer safely around danger!
quests.funFact: A buoy is anchored to the sea floor below, so it always bobs in the very same spot!

quests.instruction: Which specially trained expert boards a large ship to guide it safely into a tricky harbor?
quests.hint: Think about the local expert who climbs aboard a huge ship to guide it safely through a tricky harbor entrance.
quests.explanation: A harbor pilot guides ships safely into a harbor. Harbor pilots know every detail of their local waters!
quests.funFact: A harbor pilot knows the exact depths and currents of their harbor better than anyone else aboard!

quests.instruction: Which skilled worker controls a tall crane to lift and move heavy cargo?
quests.hint: Think about the skilled worker sitting high in the cab of a tall crane, carefully lifting a heavy container.
quests.explanation: A crane operator controls a crane to lift cargo. Crane operators work carefully high above a busy port!
quests.funFact: A skilled crane operator can lift and place a heavy container with amazing, careful precision!

quests.instruction: Which helpful worker carries a traveler's heavy bags at a station or hotel?
quests.hint: Think about the helpful worker who carries your heavy suitcases for you at a busy train station.
quests.explanation: A baggage porter carries a traveler's heavy bags. Baggage porters help make traveling much easier!
quests.funFact: A baggage porter can often carry several heavy suitcases at once, all with practiced ease!

quests.instruction: Which airport worker helps travelers carry and check their luggage curbside?
quests.hint: Think about the friendly worker right outside the airport entrance, helping you check your bags curbside.
quests.explanation: A skycap is an airport worker who helps with luggage. Skycaps check bags for travelers right outside the airport!
quests.funFact: Using a skycap curbside can help a traveler skip a long line inside the airport!

quests.instruction: Which airport worker checks tickets and helps passengers board the correct flight?
quests.hint: Think about the worker standing at the boarding gate, checking each traveler's ticket before they board.
quests.explanation: A gate agent checks tickets for boarding. Gate agents help passengers board the correct flight smoothly!
quests.funFact: A gate agent helps make sure every single passenger boards the right plane, right on schedule!

quests.instruction: Which official checks travelers and their bags when entering a new country?
quests.hint: Think about the official at the airport who checks your passport and bags after you land in a new country.
quests.explanation: A customs officer checks travelers entering a country. Customs officers help keep international travel safe!
quests.funFact: A customs officer helps welcome travelers while making sure everyone's trip stays safe and fair!

quests.instruction: Which team of workers checks bags and travelers to keep everyone safe before boarding?
quests.hint: Think about the team at the airport checking bags on a scanner belt to help keep every flight safe.
quests.explanation: Airport security checks bags and travelers for safety. Airport security teams help keep every flight safe!
quests.funFact: Airport security teams work around the clock to help keep millions of travelers safe every single day!

quests.instruction: Which desk at a station or airport is where travelers pick up or buy their ticket?
quests.hint: Think about the desk where a worker hands you your ticket before you head to your gate or platform.
quests.explanation: A ticket counter is a desk for picking up tickets. Travelers visit a ticket counter before their trip!
quests.funFact: A busy ticket counter might help hundreds of travelers on a single busy travel day!

quests.instruction: Which airport counter is where travelers show their ticket and drop off checked luggage?
quests.hint: Think about the counter at the airport where you show your ticket and hand over your suitcase to be checked.
quests.explanation: A check-in desk is where travelers drop off luggage. Passengers visit a check-in desk before heading to security!
quests.funFact: Checking in early at the check-in desk helps a traveler avoid feeling rushed before their flight!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a region of the world that shares the very same clock time?
quests.hint: Think about how the clock time changes when you travel very far east or west to a new region.
quests.explanation: A time zone is a region sharing the same clock time. Long flights often cross into a brand new time zone!
quests.funFact: Flying across several time zones can make the very same day feel much longer or shorter!

quests.instruction: Which tired, sleepy feeling happens after flying quickly across several time zones?
quests.hint: Think about feeling extra tired and sleepy at strange times after flying a long way across several time zones.
quests.explanation: Jet lag is a tired feeling after crossing time zones. Travelers often feel jet lag after a very long flight!
quests.funFact: Getting some sunlight and rest can help a traveler's body adjust more quickly after jet lag!

quests.instruction: Which notebook do travelers use to write down memories from their trip?
quests.hint: Think about the notebook a traveler carries to write down and remember exciting moments from their trip.
quests.explanation: A travel journal is a notebook for writing trip memories. Travelers fill a travel journal with exciting stories!
quests.funFact: Writing in a travel journal each day helps a traveler remember every detail of their exciting trip!

quests.instruction: Which small picture card do travelers mail to friends and family from a faraway place?
quests.hint: Think about the small card with a pretty picture that you write on and mail home during a trip.
quests.explanation: A postcard is a small picture card mailed from a trip. Travelers send a postcard to share their adventures!
quests.funFact: Collecting postcards from every place you visit is a fun way to remember a whole trip!

quests.instruction: Which small item is bought or kept to remember a special trip?
quests.hint: Think about the small item you bring home from a trip just to help you remember the wonderful adventure.
quests.explanation: A souvenir is a small item kept to remember a trip. Travelers often bring home a souvenir from their journey!
quests.funFact: A simple souvenir, like a shell or a small toy, can bring back happy memories for years to come!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a fun, long journey taken mostly by car?
quests.hint: Think about a long, exciting journey in the family car, stopping at new and interesting places along the way.
quests.explanation: A road trip is a long journey taken by car. Families enjoy stopping at new places during a fun road trip!
quests.funFact: A great road trip is often just as fun as the exciting destination at the very end!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a trip taken for rest, fun, and relaxation away from everyday life?
quests.hint: Think about the exciting trip a family takes to relax, explore, and have fun away from their normal routine.
quests.explanation: A vacation is a trip for rest and relaxation. Families look forward to a fun vacation together!
quests.funFact: Planning a vacation is often just as exciting as the wonderful trip itself!
